tldr: Saturn in Capricorn: discipline is strong, structural, and built for long-range mastery.
body: With Saturn in Capricorn, the work is responsibility, ambition, endurance, and wise authority. Saturn is at home here, so effort can become legacy when it does not harden the heart.
gift: Strategy, resilience, leadership, and the ability to build something that lasts.
challenge: Workaholism, emotional austerity, and equating worth with achievement.
note: Authored from Marie Satori planet-through-sign material.
